params.body:
The only per-campaign export on /finance was the Transactions tab with its campaign filter. The Tax certificates and Invoices tabs exported every campaign, and a campaign's own page had no export at all.

## Changes

- **Export on the campaign page**: `/campaign/<slug>/manage` gets "Export to Excel", every transaction of that campaign in the same columns as the finance export (tax certificate, invoice, address, invoice and certificate numbers). Served by the new `GET /api/finance-export?token=…&campaign=<slug>`, gated by FINANCE_TOKEN. The file holds national registry numbers and addresses, so the campaign manager's own page does not offer it.
- **One ledger, one format**: the code that joins Mollie payments to donor docs and builds an export row moves from `finance.astro` to `src/lib/ledger.ts`; the columns and the CSV format (semicolons, comma decimals, BOM) to `src/lib/csv.ts`. The finance page reads its export columns from there, so the page and the endpoint cannot drift apart.
- **Campaign filter on the request tabs**: Tax certificates and Invoices get a campaign select with a count. Their export follows it and puts the campaign in the file name.
- **Campaigns tab**: the campaign name, already a link to the manage page, is now underlined. "Open" next to "Copy link" opens the manager's own view in a new tab.
- **No em dashes or middots** on the campaign pages: "Anonymous" and "-" for hidden or missing values, parentheses on the language labels, commas in the titles.

## Verification

- `npm test`: 59 unit tests pass, including the new `tests/unit/ledger.test.ts` (attribution by payment and customer id, metadata fallback, address rules on repeat charges, numbers, the CSV format).
- A local build with Sanity and Mollie swapped for fixture stubs, driven by Playwright: 19 new checks pass. The campaign export has the same header and rows as the Transactions export filtered to that campaign; the tab filters and their exports follow the selected campaign; the endpoint answers 401 without the finance token, also with a manager token; no em dash or middot on /finance or the campaign pages. The 25 checks of the previous change still pass after the ledger move.

Not changed: the donations table on the manage page still runs off the screen at phone width.
params.title: Finance: export per campaign, campaign filter on request tabs, open link
